issues.message: A architecture view requires at least two meaningful nodes.
Architecture views require at least one relationship or meaningful boundary.
c4-container needs its notation-specific C4 element type.
C4 container/component nodes should state their technology.
Reference-architecture views usually need at least three named phase columns.
Official provider icons are required for service-icon nodes: system.
